title: GraphAD: Interaction Scene Graph for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
status: Core paper: method and tables checked
representation_or_relations: DSG has per-agent-per-modality future trajectory nodes; edge KNN by min synchronous future distance min_t ||x_i(t)-x_j(t)||; SSG edges from future proposal points to lane centerline/divider/boundary/crosswalk coordinates
information_and_objective: Camera BEV + TrackFormer + MapFormer; trajectory proposals; losses for depth/tracking/map/motion/occupancy/planning
evidence_or_relevance: NuScenes open-loop avg L2 0.68m and collision 0.12%; DSG+SSG forecast minADE/minFDE/MR 0.665/0.989/0.160; generic attention variant 0.678/1.000/0.160
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Strongest two-graph and mode-indexed future-interaction prior; map perception and end-to-end supervised planning do not test critic-only SAC gains

title: Reasoning Multi-Agent Behavioral Topology for Interactive Autonomous Driving (BeTop)
status: Core paper: method and tables checked
representation_or_relations: Agent-pair future topology edges from braid/intertwine indicators over future trajectories; topology-guided local attention
information_and_objective: Future joint trajectories supervise topology; scene encoder uses agent history and map polylines; iterative multimodal prediction/planning
evidence_or_relevance: nuPlan Test14-Inter PDMScore .894 vs PlanTF .871; no-local-attention CLS .804 vs full .857; future topology is one-step only
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Blocks generic future behavioral topology plus attention; not off-policy SAC critic or explicit resource entry-clearance model

title: T2SG: Traffic Topology Scene Graph for Topology Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
status: Core paper: graph definition and results checked
representation_or_relations: Road-only topology graph; directed lane connectivity E_ll and lane-to-signal/traffic-element E_lt; geometry-guided global lane aggregation
information_and_objective: Supervised map/topology graph generation from OpenLane-V2 perception inputs; Lane Aggregation Layer and Counterfactual Intervention Layer
evidence_or_relevance: Subset-A OLS 46.3; TOP_ll 24.1 vs TopoNet 10.9; TOP_lt 29.5 vs 23.8
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Explicit lane topology/signals are prior art; map-generation scores do not establish policy gains with exact SUMO map

title: SeqGrowGraph: Learning Lane Topology as a Chain of Graph Expansions
status: Core paper: formulation and ablations screened
representation_or_relations: Directed graph with intersections as vertices and lane centerlines as edges; autoregressive graph expansion, adjacency matrix, quadratic Bezier geometry, DFS serialization
information_and_objective: Supervised lane graph construction on nuScenes and Argoverse 2; not dynamic agent behavior
evidence_or_relevance: Paper reports state-of-the-art lane-graph generation; exact table values not transcribed in this note
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Direct lane-connectivity prior but perception/map-construction task, not known-map policy representation

title: Don't Shake the Wheel: Momentum-Aware Planning in End-to-End Autonomous Driving (MomAD)
status: Core paper: method and official results checked
representation_or_relations: Hausdorff-match current plan modes to prior paths; cross-attend current plan query with historical queries for perception context; TTM is trajectory matching, not lane graph topology
information_and_objective: Temporal planning/perception context and robust instance denoising in end-to-end perception/planning
evidence_or_relevance: NuScenes 6s SparseDrive vs MomAD: L2 2.95 vs 2.45m; collision 2.33 vs 2.13%; TPC 1.99 vs 1.61m; separate Bench2Drive result reports up to +16.3% success
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Temporal scene/query context already has prior art; closed-loop system differs from critic-only SAC and results do not isolate state encoder

title: Future-Aware Interaction Network for Motion Forecasting (FINet)
status: Core paper: method, AV2 table, and efficiency table checked
representation_or_relations: Future-trajectory-aware scene encoding; Mamba spatial interaction and temporal refinement; adaptive token reordering
information_and_objective: Supervised motion forecasting using agent histories, lane centerlines, and future trajectory targets
evidence_or_relevance: Argoverse 2: minADE6 .66, minFDE6 1.27, MR6 .15; 1.47G FLOPs / 17.72ms / 3.7M params vs QCNet 28G / 54.55ms / 7.7M
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Blocks generic future-aware spatiotemporal scene encoding; forecasting metrics are not closed-loop SAC evidence

title: Communication-free Distributed Control Algorithm for autonomous vehicles at intersections (CfDCA)
status: Direct cross-disciplinary conflict-resource prior; method sections checked
representation_or_relations: Vehicle and conflict-zone resource vertices; directed requirement/acquisition edges; path-based zone sets and entry/exit/clearance/priority logic
information_and_objective: Deterministic distributed controller; fixed lane paths; all vehicles assumed to follow protocol
evidence_or_relevance: Paper gives safety/deadlock arguments and intersection traffic simulations
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Conflict-resource graph and event times are not new alone; no multimodal learned critic or mode-preserving SAC value comparison

title: Flow Matching-Based Autonomous Driving Planning with Advanced Interactive Behavior Modeling (Flow Planner)
status: Screened at official abstract and repo
representation_or_relations: Fine trajectory tokens; temporal-spatial planning/scene fusion; inference-time interaction reweighting under classifier-free guidance
information_and_objective: Flow-matching multimodal planning trained/evaluated in nuPlan and interPlan
evidence_or_relevance: Official abstract/repo reports SOTA among learning-based planners; exact numbers omitted from this screen
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Relevant interactive closed-loop planner but no direct SAC critic comparison; don't infer from its scores

title: GoIRL: Graph-Oriented Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Trajectory Prediction
representation_or_relations: Lane-graph features aggregated into grid space; MaxEnt IRL reward distribution and multimodal plans
information_and_objective: Supervised/IRL motion forecasting on Argoverse and nuScenes
evidence_or_relevance: Authors report SOTA and generalization over supervised baselines; no numbers transcribed
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Lane graph + reward inference + multimodal future is prior art; task is prediction, not online critic

title: InteractionMap: Improving Online Vectorized HDMap Construction with Interaction
representation_or_relations: Point-to-instance spatial relation and hierarchical temporal fusion for vectorized HD map construction
evidence_or_relevance: Official abstract reports SOTA map construction
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Map perception does not test policy state representation with known map

title: Foresight in Motion: Reinforcing Trajectory Prediction with Reward Heuristics
representation_or_relations: Query-centric reward-guided multimodal trajectory prediction; IRL-style future reasoning
information_and_objective: Future trajectory/reward labels for prediction/planning forecast
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Relevant future-intent/reward representation prior; not evidence of a graph critic novelty

title: SGDrive: Scene-to-Goal Hierarchical World Cognition for Autonomous Driving
representation_or_relations: Scene-agent-goal hierarchy with structured spatial-temporal VLM representations
evidence_or_relevance: Official abstract reports SOTA among camera-only methods
limit_for_known_map_SAC_critic: Recent structured scene-to-goal prior; not known-map SUMO or SAC critic

title: TopoStreamer: Temporal Lane Segment Topology Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
status: Screened; not treated as peer-reviewed core evidence
representation_or_relations: Temporal lane-segment topology and streaming lane perception
evidence_or_relevance: Abstract reports lane-segment mAP +3.0 and OLS +1.7
